title: fix(app-shell): a pick far down a Setup catalog list no longer leaves its section out of view
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-sales"} -->
_Requested by **Sales** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01D5bWFY3rFzgJcytD5gD4Uu?thread=cmsg_01D5bWFY3rFzgJcytD5gD4UuDJAbBe3iTrFcF7GZrucZ32)_

Fixes #37532

## What changes

- `CatalogAssignmentPage` (`app-shell/src/views/setup/CatalogAssignmentPage.tsx`), the layout Setup's catalog pages share (Recycle Bin, Position holders, Permission set assignments):
  - On two columns (`md:`) the catalog list is `sticky` with its own scroll (`md:max-h-[calc(100svh-var(--os-chrome-banners,0px)-3rem)] md:overflow-y-auto md:self-start`), so the picked item's section stays at the top of the visible area however far down the list the pick was.
  - On one column (a phone), a pick the administrator makes brings the section into view (`scrollIntoView({ block: 'start' })`) when its top is above the viewport or below its middle. A link that opens an item by name does not move the scroll.
  - The list and the section carry `data-testid`s (`<testId>-list`, `<testId>-section`).

## Why

The object list and the result pane shared the page's one scroll. With a long list (38 objects, about 2000 px, in the app the card measured) an administrator scrolled down to an object near the end, chose it, and its records, Restore buttons and Empty button were above the visible area: the right side read blank, as if the bin were empty.

Measured on `main` in a local console against `examples/app-crm` (`--fresh`), the object list padded to about 2000 px to stand in for the card's 38 objects, the last object picked:

| viewport | before: section heading top | after: section heading top |
|---|---|---|
| 1280×768 | −1420 px (out of view) | 61 px; the list scrolled itself 1444 px |
| 390×844 | 800 px (heading only, records below the fold) | 627 px, section and its empty state whole on screen |
| 1280×420 | (list fits) | 61 px; list scrolled 1792 px |

## Verification

- New `views/setup/CatalogAssignmentPage.scroll-37532.test.tsx` (5 cases, through Position holders): the list's two-column classes; a pick whose section is below the viewport, and one whose section is above it, scroll the section into view; a pick whose section is already in view does not; a link naming an item does not. With `CatalogAssignmentPage.tsx` restored from `main`, 3 of the 5 go red (the two "does not scroll" cases are controls).
- `pnpm --dir ui exec vitest run packages/app-shell/src/views/setup/`: 207 tests green.
- `type-check` for `@object-ui/app-shell`: clean. `eslint` on the changed files: 0 errors (2 warnings already on `main`).
- `overlap-check`: exit 0.
